responsibility: This file implements source-file search path management for the mc front end. It stores user and initial search paths plus configurable default extensions for definition and implementation/program modules, resolves stem names into candidate .def or .mod filenames through mcFileName helpers, searches colon-separated directories for existing files using SFIO, and returns full paths as DynamicStrings, making it the compiler's module source locator.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the executable implementation of the search subsystem: it owns the module state for user and initial paths plus definition/implementation extensions, and defines the file-locating routines that walk colon-separated directories and probe the filesystem. The same-stem header only declares that API.
